descriptionFromApi:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we are tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. As an NVIDIAN, you will address challenges spanning architecture, silicon, firmware, software, and production - and excellent judgment matters as much as technical depth! We are the Silicon Power Team within the Silicon Co-Design Group. We architect and deliver groundbreaking solutions for productizing NVIDIAs chips across consumer, professional, server, embedded, mobile, and automotive markets. Silicon characterization, correlation to arch and design expectations, product spec finalization, and productization techniques and infrastructure are our day-to-day work - always on the bleeding edge of the industry. Small decisions here have outsized impact on performance, efficiency, reliability, bring-up speed, and ultimately what the product delivers in the field.

We are hiring a Senior Silicon Power Engineer to own power-feature productization on a flagship silicon program. This is not a coordination role, and it is not a compliance role - it is the seat where power features either work at scale or become the reason a program slips. The two highest-leverage problems in this seat:

  • Close the hardest multi-functional power failures before they gate a program. Take ambiguous, cross-boundary issues across architecture, firmware, validation, and platform to root-cause closure - with productized fixes and reusable methodology the next program can inherit.

  • Build AI-enabled characterization as a real capability, not a demo. Every bring-up generates terabytes of characterization, shmoo, and telemetry data. Deploy AI workflows for data analysis, metric extraction, trend detection, and cross-bring-up correlation - with the guardrails and validation discipline to make them trustworthy enough to gate production decisions!

What you ll be doing:

  • Lead the effort across architecture, validation, firmware, software, and production teams to keep the programs power and low-power productization strategy clear, executable, and on track.

  • Characterize and validate new power-saving features, debug silicon issues, and work with SW/FW teams to productize industry-defining capabilities.

  • Resolve complex silicon issues through structured hypotheses, measurement plans, and root-cause closure - and codify the fixes as reusable methodology across programs.

  • Design and deploy AI-enabled workflows to automate data analysis, metric extraction, trend checks, and report generation across multiple bring-ups - with explicit guardrails and measurable workflow impact.

  • Serve as the key technical owner for multi-functional decisions, issues, and tradeoffs across power, thermal, performance, firmware, and schedule constraints.

  • Partner with globally distributed teams - system architects, chip and board designers, SW/FW engineers, applications, reliability specialists, ATE engineers, and PMs - including counterpart engineers in India and other major hubs.

What we need to see:

  • BS + 5 years, or MS + 4 years, in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience), with a proven track record in post-silicon bring-up and validation of silicon power features on complex ASIC or SoC programs.

  • Deep hands-on expertise in power-saving mechanisms, power characterization, tester-to-system correlation, and lab fundamentals (oscilloscopes, DMM, DAQ, debuggers) - with at least one specific example of taking an ambiguous power failure to root-cause closure with a productized fix.

  • Strong end-to-end understanding of silicon behavior across architecture, firmware, validation, and platform interactions, and a demonstrated ability to make sound tradeoff decisions across power, thermal, performance, firmware, design, validation, and schedule constraints.

  • Demonstrated AI-enabled workflow you built or scaled for silicon characterization or validation - with adoption beyond yourself, measurable workflow impact, and clear validation discipline, observability, and guardrails.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Deep hands-on subsystem expertise across Windows and Linux low-power states, silicon power behavior, transistor/device physics, silicon reliability, and aging mechanisms - including original power-analysis methodology adopted by other programs.

  • Silicon-level impact you personally drove - faster bring-up, stronger characterization coverage, better debug turnaround, or methodology improvements that reduced risk across programs, backed by artifacts, patents, or published technical work.

  • Experience partnering deeply with a counterpart team in India or another major engineering hub - shared on-call, shared metrics, and shared culture across geographies.

  • AI work that goes beyond personal-copilot use - agentic workflows, RAG-grounded debug assistants, ML-driven characterization analytics, or automated trend detection - deployed at team scope with adoption metrics

If you want to solve ambiguous silicon problems, build original methodology rather than inherit it, and use AI with the rigor required for production decisions, this role offers unusually broad ownership and unusually high leverage ! We are looking for someone who improves how NVIDIA characterizes, validates, and productizes power features across ASIC programs.

Job Summary

We are seeking a hands-on Manager - Global Accounting, Consolidation Reporting to own the month-end close, multi-entity consolidation, and reporting for a fast-growing consumer and technology company operating across 8+ legal entities (US, India, UK, Canada, China, Hong Kong, and 4 new EU entities launching soon).

This role reports to the Director of Accounting and manages a team of 4 (Sheeba, Saurabh, and 2 new hires - Sr GL Analyst and FA Analyst). You will own the T+3 soft / T+6 hard / T+7 reporting close cadence, group consolidation, forex restatement, payroll accounting, intercompany, equity accounting (SBC/ESOPs), and audit coordination with Deloitte (US) and local firms.

The ideal candidate is a qualified Chartered Accountant with 8-10 years of post-qualification experience running global US GAAP close, comfortable owning technical accounting judgments, and ready to build accounting maturity as the company scales into new geographies.

You will work closely with the Finance Controller, VP Accounting (US), FPA, Payroll Director, Tax Lead, and external auditors.

  • Own the global month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close cadence: T+3 soft / T+6 hard / T+7 reporting across all 11+ entities.
  • Own multi-entity consolidation and elimination entries, including forex restatement across 8+ base currencies (USD, INR, GBP, CAD, CNY, HKD, EUR).
  • Own intercompany transactions between US parent and all subsidiaries, including cross-entity postings, netting, and transfer pricing entries in coordination with the Tax Lead.
  • Own Fixed Assets accounting (across all entities) until the FA Analyst is hired; then transition to review-only.
  • Own end-to-end statutory and regulatory compliance for the accounting function across three regions - Europe (UK + Germany, Spain, Netherlands, France) - including books-and-records compliance, statutory filings, statutory audits, and coordination with local consultants and regulators. Partner with the Tax Lead on tax-specific filings.
  • Lead the annual audit with local audit firms across 6+ geographies. Own PBC lists, coordination, and audit deliverables.

  • Chartered Accountant (CA) with 8-10 years of post-qualification experience.
  • At least 4-5 years managing a global accounting team in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment.

  • Experience with NetSuite (OneWorld, Multi-Book) is required. Working knowledge of Coupa (AP), Numeric (close management), Avalara (tax), Carta (equity) is a strong plus.
  • Experience owning close + consolidation across 5+ legal entities and multiple base currencies.
  • Big 4 background (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG) preferred. Prior experience at a fast-growing consumer or tech company preferred.
  • Hands-on experience managing statutory and regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions (US, India, Europe). Familiarity with US GAAP and local GAAPs (Ind AS, F/ IFRS for UK, EU-country local GAAPs).

  • Strong people leadership skills; ability to coach analysts and grow a team.
  • Strong problem-solving, ownership, and stakeholder management (US-based leadership + external auditors).
  • Comfort in a fast-moving environment with expanding geographic footprint (EU launch imminent).

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era You re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Solution Architect - Marketing Cloud Next is the primary client-facing technical authority for migrations from legacy marketing automation platforms - Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, legacy Salesforce Marketing Cloud Classic - to Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Salesforce Data Cloud. This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy and technical platform design: owning the end-to-end solution blueprint, leading functional discovery workshops, translating complex marketing business requirements into a Salesforce MCN solution architecture, and governing the functional quality of deliverables across the migration wave.

Solution Architect owns the solution strategy, functional design and client relationship - ensuring the migrated platform delivers the business outcomes the clients marketing operations, CRM and digital teams need, while the Technical Architect delivers the technical implementation. Together with the Data Cloud Architect, the SA ensures migrated subscriber data, consent records and journey logic land in a well-governed, AI-ready, unified customer platform that sets the client up for Agentforce personalisation and Data Cloud activation post go-live.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead end-to-end functional discovery - running structured workshops with client marketing operations, CRM, data, compliance and digital teams to capture current-state platform capabilities, subscriber data architecture, journey complexity, consent model and integration dependencies across all legacy marketing platforms.

  • Own the solution blueprint - designing the Marketing Cloud Next target architecture, including Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Mobile Studio and Data Cloud integration design, translating legacy platform features into MCN-native equivalents and identifying where custom development is required.

  • Author the migration approach document - defining the phased migration strategy, wave sequencing, subscriber migration methodology, journey migration priority framework, legacy platform deprecation schedule and business cutover approach with go/no-go criteria.

  • Design the subscriber data migration strategy - at the functional level: defining which subscriber segments migrate, the business rules governing data transformation, suppression list governance, consent record mapping requirements and the subscriber validation criteria the business will use to sign off each data wave.

  • Own the consent and compliance architecture - mapping legacy consent records, preference data and suppression lists to Marketing Cloud Next consent model and Data Cloud consent API, ensuring GDPR, CAN-SPAM, CASL and POPI obligations are met in the migrated platform from day one.

  • Design the journey migration blueprint - inventorying and assessing all legacy journeys, drip campaigns and triggered sends; prioritising for migration, rebuild or retirement; mapping legacy automation logic to Journey Builder native capabilities; and defining the functional acceptance criteria for each migrated journey.

  • Lead Data Cloud integration design - defining the unified customer profile architecture, data stream sources, identity resolution business rules, audience segmentation strategy and activation targets for Marketing Cloud Next - in collaboration with the Data Cloud Architect.

  • Manage scope and functional sign-off - maintaining the solution scope register, managing scope change requests, producing functional design documents and obtaining formal business sign-off at each MDLC phase gate before the Technical Architect begins build.

  • Serve as Trusted Advisor to the client - building long-term relationships with client marketing technology leads, digital directors, CDOs and Enterprise Architects; providing candid guidance on MCN platform capabilities, migration trade-offs and post-migration marketing strategy.

  • Govern functional quality of deliverables - reviewing all functional design documents, process maps, data mapping sheets, journey design artefacts and user acceptance test scripts produced by the track team to ensure they meet factory quality standards and client expectations.

  • Validate business process equivalence post-migration - leading user acceptance testing (UAT) planning, supporting client business users through UAT execution, managing defect triage and confirming that migrated journeys, subscriber segments and send logic deliver the same business outcomes as the legacy platform.

  • Lead email deliverability strategy - advising on IP warm-up planning, domain authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), sender reputation management and inbox placement testing strategy post-migration.

  • Contribute to the Migration Factory - building reusable MCN solution design templates, discovery workshop guides, journey migration assessment frameworks, consent architecture blueprints and migration approach documents for the factory accelerator library.

  • Support pre-sales and solutioning - contributing to proposal development, migration scope estimation, resource planning and solution presentations for prospective Marketing Cloud Next migration engagements.

Role Overview: Build AI Systems We Can Trust

We are seeking a Senior AI Evaluation & Reliability Engineer passionate about solving one of the most critical challenges in modern software: How do we guarantee an AI system is accurate, improving, and delivering tangible business value?

In this role, you will treat model performance and agentic reliability as core software engineering disciplines. Moving far beyond manual prompt inspection, you will design production-grade evaluation systems for LLMs, RAG applications, and multi-agent workflows. Beyond the code, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to our North American enterprise clients, a mentor to our engineering teams, and a key driver connecting AI performance directly to ROI.


What You Will Own-


1. Architect Production-Grade Evaluation Pipelines

  • Build and maintain end-to-end programmatic evaluation frameworks to continuously validate production LLM outputs, RAG architectures, and multi-agent systems.
  • Integrate automated evaluation suites into CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to catch regressions before deployment.
  • Establish statistically rigorous metric suites measuring Faithfulness, Context Precision, Answer Relevance, Semantic Drift, and Task Completion Rates.

2. Engineer "LLM-as-a-Judge" Systems & Manage Economics

  • Design and optimize scalable LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks, building calibration loops against human ground-truth datasets to mitigate judge-specific biases.
  • Manage Evaluation ROI: Running comprehensive evaluations burns tokens. You will design tiered evaluation routing using fast heuristic graders for simple checks and powerful LLMs for complex judging, balancing quality, latency, and inference spend.

3. Benchmark RAG & Synthetic Data

  • Systematically benchmark RAG systems across embedding models, vector indexing, chunking strategies, and re-ranking algorithms.
  • Generate programmatic synthetic datasets and adversarial scenarios to stress-test agent reasoning, tool-calling precision, and failure recovery.

4. Drive Enterprise Consulting & Presales

  • Act as the principal technical authority for North American clients, leading architectural discussions and translating complex probabilistic metrics into actionable business strategies.
  • Build executive-friendly AI quality and ROI scorecards to help clients establish Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and risk-acceptance thresholds.
  • Actively partner with Sales and Product teams in discovery calls, shaping technical proposals and demonstrating our AI capabilities to win strategic engagements.

5. Coach Engineers & Raise the Bar

  • Mentor internal teams, moving engineers from basic prompt experimentation to disciplined, programmatic AI engineering.
  • Build reusable frameworks, playbooks, and internal accelerators to scale our AI evaluation capabilities organization-wide.

What We Are Looking For-


AI Evaluation Mastery

  • Proven track record of building and deploying programmatic evaluation systems in production.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with LLM-as-a-Judge calibration, RAG evaluation, and mitigating evaluation bias.
  • Mastery of modern evaluation tooling: DeepEval, Ragas, TruLens, LangSmith, DSPy, Promptfoo, or equivalent.

Software Engineering & Backend Foundations

  • Programming Depth: Advanced proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript.
  • Architecture: Strong experience with asynchronous API design, CI/CD, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma).
  • Cost Optimization: Proven ability to manage strict cost-control strategies for model inference and evaluation loops.

Consulting & Leadership

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a history of interfacing directly with enterprise stakeholders (CTO/COO level).
  • A consultative problem-solving mindset: the ability to clearly articulate the trade-offs between model latency, inference cost, and output accuracy.
  • A strong desire to mentor, lead, and stay at the bleeding edge of emerging AI technologies.

Why This Role Matters

The next generation of industry-leading AI companies won't just be the ones with access to the best models. They will be the ones that can confidently measure AI, trust AI, and translate that reliability into actual business value. If you want to build that future with us, we'd love to hear from you.

  • Create directed and exploratory tests based on detailed examination of system software architecture, hardware schematics, and protocol specifications.

descriptionFromApi:
About Leena AI

Leena AI is an enterprise agentic AI platform used by Fortune 500 companies to automate work across IT, HR, and Finance. Our AI agents resolve employees everyday problems - a locked account, a broken app, a new-laptop request - end to end, without a human in the loop. We are building the largest library of ready-to-use IT agents in the industry, and this role sits at the heart of that effort.

About the role

We are looking for someone who deeply understands how enterprise IT actually runs - especially in Microsoft-centric environments - and wants to turn that knowledge into products. You will design and build the IT agents that ship with our platform: agents that reset passwords, fix Outlook and Teams issues, install approved apps, manage access and licenses, and handle hundreds of other everyday IT requests.

This is not a traditional sysadmin or support job, and it is not a hardcore coding job either. It is a builder role: you take the IT processes you have run for years, connect them to the systems where they live (Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, ServiceNow, and more), and package them as reliable, reusable agents that work out of the box for any large enterprise.

What you will do

- Build a large library of IT agents - design how each agent should work, what steps it takes, what approvals and safety checks it needs, and how success is measured.

- Own our Microsoft-side integrations - make agents work smoothly with Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID (Azure AD), Exchange Online, Teams, and Azure, using Microsofts standard connection points.

- Connect agents to IT service desks - ServiceNow and similar tools for tickets, approvals, service catalogs, and knowledge.

- Work directly with enterprise customers - understand how their IT environment is set up, map their use cases to our agents, and configure and launch agents for them.

- Productize what you learn - when you solve something new for one customer, turn it into an out-of-the-box agent every customer can use.

- Set the guardrails - decide what an agent may do on its own, what needs approval, and what should only be guided self-help, so automation stays safe and auditable.

- Partner with product and engineering - be the voice of real-world IT in how the platform evolves.

What we are looking for

- 8-12 years in enterprise IT - in roles like IT administration, endpoint or identity management, IT automation, integrations, or solution consulting.

- Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft products - Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID (Azure AD), Exchange, and Teams. You should know these environments from running them, not just from reading about them.

- Comfort connecting systems together - you have worked with Microsoft Graph, PowerShell, or similar ways of automating and integrating IT tools. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should not be afraid of scripts and APIs.

- ITSM experience - you know how tickets, approvals, and service catalogs work in tools like ServiceNow.

- A process mind - you can take a messy, human-driven IT process and describe it as clear, repeatable steps with the right checks.

- Customer-facing polish - you can sit with a CIOs team, understand their environment, and explain technical things in simple language.

- No prior AI experience required - if you know enterprise IT well, we will teach you how to build agents.

Nice to have

- Experience with Azure infrastructure, virtual desktops (Citrix), or security tools like Microsoft Defender.

- Exposure to AI assistants, chatbots, or workflow automation platforms.

- Experience working with large global enterprises or Fortune 500 IT teams.

Why join us

You will define what AI-driven IT looks like for some of the worlds biggest companies. Everything you build ships to real users at scale, and the agent library you create becomes a core part of the product - not an internal tool. If you have spent a decade running enterprise IT and want your next decade to be about automating it, this is the role.

This role ensures that employees receive timely, professional, and effective IT support for workplace technology, including laptops, mobile devices, collaboration tools, business applications, and office IT services. 1. Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and support a regional team of Technical Engineers, Site IT Leads and Service desk agents.
  • Coordinate daily support activities, workloads, priorities, and shift coverage across the region (s).
  • Provide guidance on complex incidents, service requests, escalations,
  • Support team development through mentoring, feedback, knowledge sharing, and performance input.
  • Promote a customer-focused, professional, and service-oriented team culture.

2. End user support delivery

  • Ensure high-quality support for end user devices, operating systems, productivity tools, collaboration platforms, printers, peripherals, Fixed and mobile telephony, and standard business applications.

  • Monitor ticket queues to ensure timely resolution, proper prioritization, and accurate documentation.
  • Act as an escalation point for unresolved or high-impact support issues.

  • Ensure the regional IT Service desks executes issues and requests in line with expectations, and in accordance to the Global Service desk owner.

  • Coordinate local and regional IT support activities across offices, sites, or countries within the assigned region.

  • Act as regional hub lead for other teams within the same region of hub
  • Assist with regional rollouts, technology refreshes, software deployments, and change initiatives.
  • Maintain awareness of regional business needs, local constraints, and service improvement opportunities.

4. Asset, Compliance security

  • Ensure accurate management of IT assets, including laptops, mobile devices, accessories, and peripherals.
  • Support hardware lifecycle activities, inventory controls, forecasting, disposals. and audit requirements in alignment with Global Hardware Asset Manager.
  • Ensure end user support activities follow company security policies and compliance standards.
  • Promote secure working practices, including device encryption, access control, patching, and data protection.
  • Escalate security incidents or policy breaches through the appropriate channels.

5. Service coordinator

  • Manage relationships with managed (security) service providers.
  • Acts as local host in global projects, roll-outs adaptive change requests.
  • Provide insight in impact that global initiatives have on local business.
  • Monitor all IT incidents requests escalated by users in the local domain.
  • Work with the respective Service Owners and collaborate with the partners to ensure proper follow-up.
  • Facilitate contact points for all supporting activities for vendors to perform services onsite when needed
  • Track support performance, recurring issues, service trends, and user feedback.

  • Ensure incidents, requests, changes, and problems are handled according to ITIL-aligned practices.
  • Support root cause analysis and problem management for recurring end user issues.

  • Identify problems channel towards the relevant Service Owner. Support the problem analysis.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement and standardization of DigITal processes and services.
  • Share and drive best practices.

  • Clear communication and stakeholder engagement.
  • Ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work across cultures, time zones, and regional teams.
  • Continuous improvement mindset.
  • Understands the regional dimensions
  • Stakeholder satisfaction management

Your Profile

Experience Expertise

  • 8 -10+ years of experience in end user support, service desk and regional management
  • Proven experience in end user support, desktop support, service desk, or workplace technology support.
  • Experience leading, coordinating, or mentoring IT support teams.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows and/or macOS environments, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools, mobile device support, and common enterprise applications.
  • Experience working with IT service management tools and ticketing systems.
  • Good understanding of ITIL principles, incident management, request fulfilment, escalation management, and change management.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, network connectivity, identity, and access-related issues.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and customer service skills.
  • Ability to prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced, multi-site environment.

Leadership Capabilities

  • Good stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong decision-making capability.
  • Excellent communication skills at executive level.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills.
  • Passion for continuous improvement.
  • Calm and decisive during crisis situations.
  • Strong people manager capable of developing high-performing teams.
  • A Can do mentality

Success Measures (KPIs)

The success of the role will be measured through:

  • Regional support tickets are resolved within agreed service levels.
  • End users report a high level of satisfaction with IT support.
  • Ticket queues are well managed, documented, and regularly reviewed.
  • Recurring issues are identified and addressed through service improvement actions.
  • Regional support processes are consistent with global IT standards.
  • The support team is engaged, knowledgeable, and operating effectively.

You can grow a lasting career here. We ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We ll help you learn and progress in a way that s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. A regular in Fortune 500 list, Elevance Health ranked 20 in 2022. Gail Boudreaux , President and CEO of Elevance Health has been a consistent name in the Fortune list of most powerful women and currently holds 4th rank on this list.

ABOUT CARELON

Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company that is simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system.

Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health (Previously Anthem Inc.). CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers.

Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, Limerick in Ireland and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective and efficient.

OUR MISSION VALUES

Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity

JOB POSITION

JOB RESPONSIBILITY

  • Develop and maintain microservice architecture and API management solutions using REST and gRPC for seamless deployment of AI solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists and product managers, to acquire, process, and manage data for AI/ML model integration and optimization.
  • Design and implement robust, scalable, and enterprise-grade data pipelines to support state-of-the-art AI/ML models.
  • Debug, optimize, and enhance machine learning models, ensuring quality assurance and performance improvements.
  • Familiarity with tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, and Pulumi for efficient infrastructure management.
  • Create and manage CI/CD pipelines using Git-based platforms (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins) to ensure streamlined development workflows.
  • Operate container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes, with advanced configurations and service mesh implementations, for scalable ML workload deployments.
  • Design and build scalable LLM inference architectures, employing GPU memory optimization techniques and model quantization for efficient deployment.
  • Engage in advanced prompt engineering and fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), focusing on semantic retrieval and chatbot development.
  • Document model architectures, hyperparameter optimization experiments, and validation results using version control and experiment tracking tools like MLflow or DVC.
  • Research and implement cutting-edge LLM optimization techniques, such as quantization and knowledge distillation, ensuring efficient model performance and reduced computational costs.
  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders to develop innovative and effective natural language processing solutions, specializing in text classification, sentiment analysis, and topic modeling.
  • Design and execute rigorous A/B tests for machine learning models, analyzing results to drive strategic improvements and decisions.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and advancements in AI technologies, integrating new methodologies and frameworks to continually enhance the AI engineering function.
  • Contribute to creating specialized AI solutions in healthcare, leveraging domain-specific knowledge for task adaptation and deployment.

QUALIFICATION

Minimum education: Bachelor s degree in any Engineering Stream
Specialized training, certifications, and/or other special requirements: Nice to have
Preferred education: Computer Science/Engineering.

EXPERIENCE

Minimum relevant experience - 6+ years in AI Engineering
Preferred total experience - 8 years

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES


Technical Skills:

  • Advanced proficiency in Python with expertise in data science libraries (NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn) and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow)
  • Extensive experience with LLM frameworks (Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain) and prompt engineering techniques
  • Experience with big data processing using Spark for large-scale data analytics
  • Version control and experiment tracking using Git and MLflow
  • Software Engineering Development: Advanced proficiency in Python, familiarity with Go or Rust, expertise in microservices, test-driven development, and concurrency processing.
  • DevOps Infrastructure: Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), and container orchestration (Kubernetes) with Helm and service mesh implementations.
  • LLM Infrastructure Deployment: Proficiency in LLM serving platforms such as vLLM and FastAPI, model quantization techniques, and vector database management.
  • MLOps Deployment: Utilization of containerization strategies for ML workloads, experience with model serving tools like TorchServe or TF Serving, and automated model retraining.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Strong grasp of advanced cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure) and network security for ML systems.
  • LLM Project Experience: Expertise in developing chatbots, recommendation systems, translation services, and optimizing LLMs for performance and security.
  • General Skills: Python, SQL, knowledge of machine learning frameworks (Hugging Face, TensorFlow, PyTorch), and experience with cloud platforms like AWS or GCP.
  • Experience in creating LLD for the provided architecture.
  • Experience working in microservices based architecture.

Domain Expertise:

  • Strong mathematical foundation in statistics, probability, linear algebra, and optimization
  • Deep understanding of ML and LLM development lifecycle, including fine-tuning and evaluation
  • Expertise in feature engineering, embedding optimization, and dimensionality reduction
  • Advanced knowledge of A/B testing, experimental design, and statistical hypothesis testing
  • Experience with RAG systems, vector databases, and semantic search implementation
  • Proficiency in LLM optimization techniques including quantization and knowledge distillation
  • Understanding of MLOps practices for model deployment and monitoring

Professional Competencies:

  • Strong analytical thinking with ability to solve complex ML challenges
  • Excellent communication skills for presenting technical findings to diverse audiences
  • Experience translating business requirements into data science solutions
  • Project management skills for coordinating ML experiments and deployments
  • Strong collaboration abilities for working with cross-functional teams
  • Dedication to staying current with latest ML research and best practices
  • Ability to mentor and share knowledge with team members

It is our strong belief that one is committed to a role when it is not just what the role entails, but also what lies in its periphery that completes the value circle for an associate.

This world of limitless opportunities thrives in an environment that fosters growth and well-being, and gives you purpose and the feeling of belonging.

LIFE @ CARELON

  • Extensive focus on learning and development
  • An inspiring culture built on innovation, creativity, and freedom.

  • Comprehensive range of rewards and recognitions

  • 1. Build microservices-based ML applications using Python and Docker.

  • 1. Execute time-bound Proof-of-Concepts (POCs) with open-source ML frameworks and emerging AI technologies.

  • Solid knowledge of MLOps workflows, model monitoring, drift detection, and CI/CD for ML.
  • Proficiency with Docker and microservices-based architectures.
  • Proven experience managing and mentoring a team of 5+ developers/ML engineers.

  • Excellent understanding of ML system performance optimization (latency, throughput, cost efficiency).
  • Strong problem-solving, architecture design, and stakeholder collaboration skills.

  • Knowledge of data pipelines (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster).

Strong Linux administration and scripting experience using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

Good understanding of scalable and highly available cloud infrastructure architectures.

Experience supporting or operating IoT platforms and connected-device application environments.

Exposure to NVIDIA technologies, including NVIDIA NGC Registry, DGX Cloud, or NVIDIA Omniverse.
Experience with GitOps and Argo CD for Kubernetes deployment automation.
Experience with AI/ML infrastructure and GPU-accelerated application deployments.
Experience developing automation or operational tools using Python.
Knowledge of hybrid cloud and enterprise infrastructure environments.
Cloud certifications such as AWS, GCP, or equivalent DevOps/Cloud certifications.

We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Senior Accounting Manager to own the core accounting infrastructure of a growing, global, post-Series B company.

This person will lead the company through a rigorous GAAP close, consolidation, revenue recognition, reporting, audit, payroll partnership, finance administration, and accounting systems environment.   • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, driving a disciplined, accurate, and increasingly efficient GAAP close process
  • Lead global consolidation across multiple legal entities, currencies, and jurisdictions, including intercompany accounting and eliminations
  • Own advanced and technical accounting matters, including revenue recognition, complex transactions, accounting policy, and GAAP interpretation
  • Own preparation and review of internal and external financial reporting, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery
  • Lead the evolution of the company s accounting systems, integrations, and financial data architecture, reducing manual processes and improving control and visibility
  • Partner closely with People Operations on global payroll, ensuring accurate accounting, reconciliations, controls, and coordination across payroll providers and entities
  • Oversee core finance administration, including banking, treasury administration, entity support, expense and vendor processes, accounting documentation, and related operational workflows
  • Lead the company s external financial statement audit, managing audit readiness, supporting schedules, technical accounting documentation, and auditor relationships
  • Establish and maintain accounting policies, procedures, controls, and documentation appropriate for a growing global organization
  • Partner with business leaders to ensure financial reporting accurately reflects business performance and supports decision-making
  • Proactively identify financial, accounting, systems, and process risks and resolve issues before they create downstream problems
  • Lead a deliberately lean finance organization, developing direct reports into stronger operators and increasing team capability through systems, automation, standards, and clear ownership rather than relying primarily on additional headcount

  • Active CPA required
  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, with significant experience owning close, consolidation, reporting, and technical accounting

  • Prior experience in a post-Series B or later-stage, high-growth technology company
  • Experience working with global entities, multi-entity consolidation, intercompany transactions, and international accounting operations
  • Strong experience with revenue recognition and other advanced accounting topics relevant to a SaaS or technology business
  • Demonstrated ownership of annual external audits and audit readiness
  • Strong understanding of accounting systems, ERP environments, integrations, and financial data flows

  • Experience partnering with People Operations on payroll, ideally across multiple countries or payroll providers
  • Experience managing and developing accounting professionals in a lean operating environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to move fluidly between strategic issues, technical accounting, systems architecture, and hands-on execution
  • Comfortable operating in an environment where processes are still evolving and where leaders are expected to build rather than inherit fully mature infrastructure
  • Ability to work U.S. business hours

Location

The role is remote based in India. Preference will be given to Mumbai or Bangalore based candidates.

Don't hold back

We understand some candidates may see the above and not apply because they don t meet all the qualifications. We encourage you to apply anyway; we often find talented candidates that fit many other opportunities we have and look for potential too, not just what you did in the past.

Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world s leading businesses. For our people-Kyndryls-that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

Join our team as a Technical Resolution Specialist, where you will play a pivotal role in maintaining and optimizing Kyndryl s complex, high-traffic internet site communications and network-based product systems. This isnt just a job - it s a chance to immerse yourself in cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of innovation.

As a Technical Resolution Specialist, youll be the engineer of scalable local and wide-area network solutions, bridging multiple platforms and protocols, including IP and VOIP. Your mission is to ensure seamless system performance, troubleshoot network issues, and orchestrate the installation of vital components such as routers and switches in collaboration with our trusted vendors. But thats not all - youll also be at the forefront of innovation, developing tools to automate network system deployment, administration, and monitoring, while actively participating in project planning and implementation.

This role isnt just about technical expertise; its about collaboration and growth. Youll provide training and lend your expertise to proposal writing, enhancing our collective knowledge. Youll collaborate closely with development teams to fine-tune system operability, conduct rigorous tests to ensure network redundancy and resilience, and even step up to provide on-call service coverage when needed.

At the heart of your work is a commitment to technical excellence and customer satisfaction. Youll offer expert advice on best practices, support actions, and architectural definitions, all while supporting your colleagues - be it Architects, Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), or other specialists - in delivering customer solutions.

In this role, youll thrive in a vibrant atmosphere of teamwork and collaboration, where every day brings new challenges and opportunities to apply your knowledge and expertise. Your contributions will make a significant impact on our technical team, as you focus on supporting and maintaining customer systems, resolving incidents, implementing changes, and investigating critical issues. Additionally, youll conduct system reviews, provide recommendations based on technology best practices, and serve as a trusted advisor to our valued customers.

If youre ready to take your technical skills to the next level and thrive in a role that values innovation, collaboration, and expertise - then this opportunity is tailor-made for you. Join us at Kyndryl, in shaping the future of technology and unlocking its limitless potential.

Your Future at Kyndryl

Kyndryls focus on providing innovative IT solutions to our customers means that as a part of the Technical Specialist team, you ll be working with the latest technology and will have the opportunity to learn and grow your skills. Whether you progress your career to a Technical Leader and Principal or migrate to other technical career paths such as an Architect or Data Scientist - we have opportunities you won t find anywhere else.

Key Accountabilities

  • Ship-to-Shore Connectivity (Satellite & WAN)
    • VSAT (primary maritime WAN)
    • Starlink (LEO satellite connectivity)
    • Ensure stable hybrid WAN integration with SD-WAN
    • Handle: Link failover & Latency-sensitive traffic optimization
    • Work with providers (e.g., Speedcast)
  • SD-WAN & Routing
    • Design and operate SD-WAN overlay networks
    • Manage routing protocols: BGP (iBGP / eBGP)
    • Traffic segmentation (Corporate / Internet / Voice)
    • Policy-based routing
    • Split tunneling
    • Ensure seamless integration with cloud (AWS/Azure)
  • LAN / Core / Access Networking
    • Manage enterprise Core-Access architecture (Cisco)
    • Vlans, STP, LACP, VTP
    • Switch stacking and redundancy
    • Ensure high availability across ship networks
  • Wireless Infrastructure
    • Manage Cisco WLC (AireOS / Catalyst 9800)
    • Maintain optimal RF conditions:
    • Noise / interference analysis
    • Coverage optimization
    • Troubleshoot client connectivity issues onboard ships
  • Security & Firewall Ecosystem (Fortinet)
    • Operate and manage:
    • FortiGate Firewalls (VDOM segmentation)
    • FortiManager (central policy management)
    • FortiAnalyzer (log & analytics)
    • FortiClient EMS
    • Configure: Security policies & NAT and VPNs (IPSec / SSL)
    • Maintain segmentation:
      • Corporate / Internet / OT / 3rd Party
  • Identity & Access Control
    • Manage Cisco ISE for:
    • Network access control (802.1X)
    • Authentication / authorization
    • Integrate with: Wired and wireless networks & Active Directory
  • Cloud Networking (AWS & Azure)
    • Design and support hybrid cloud connectivity
    • Manage:
      • Azure networking (VNets, NSGs, Private DNS)
      • AWS networking (VPCs, Route 53, security groups)

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Construction is the second-largest industry in the world-nearly 4x the size of SaaS-yet it still operates without the automated feedback loops that modern software teams rely on. Without real-time observability, issues are detected too late, contributing to over Trillion in annual global waste.

Doxel brings computer vision and AI to construction, giving teams real-time visibility into progress, risk, and execution. From hospitals to data centers, and from field leaders to executive teams, Doxel is used every day to support better decisions and faster delivery. Our platform is trusted by industry leaders including Shell, Genentech, HCA Healthcare, Kaiser, Turner, and Layton.

Doxel s automated progress tracking solution keeps teams aligned with hard facts that leave no ambiguity on where the project is today, where it will be tomorrow and what decisions need to be made to land it on schedule and on budget. This enables our customers to deliver projects, on average, 11% ahead of schedule with up to 16% savings on monthly cash flow.

Backed by Insight Partners and Andreessen Horowitz and with a rapidly growing team of engineers, scientists, construction veterans, and Enterprise go-to-market teams, were driven to help our customers win.

Join us as we continue our journey to transform the $15T Construction Industry!

The Role

Youll build and run the core people processes that keep our team supported and growing: how we onboard and offboard, how we manage performance and career growth, and how we recognize great work. Youll also own the implementation of our HRIS (Rippling), making sure its configured to support the team as we scale.

This is a hands-on execution role - youll be the one actually running these processes day to day, not just designing them from a distance. Youll use AI tools to optimize and streamline these processes, track outcomes compliantly, and run more efficiently as we scale.

Your Day To Day

  • HRIS Implementation. Own the implementation and ongoing configuration of Rippling - job architecture, workflows, and system setup that supports the team as we grow.
  • Performance & Career Pathing. Run our performance review and merit/promotion cycles, including calibration. Support and help evolve our career pathing framework so growth expectations are clear at every level.
  • Onboarding & Offboarding. Build and run onboarding that gets new hires productive and engaged fast, and offboarding thats clean and professional every time.
  • Learning & Development (Employee Recognition). Own our employee recognition programs, and support broader L&D efforts that help managers and employees grow.
  • Benefits & Total Rewards. Help to support benefits administration and our annual renewal process with our broker; help ensure our rewards remain competitive, understood, and efficient.
  • Immigration & Mobility. Support immigration needs (H-1B and related) in partnership with dedicated outside counsel.

What Success Looks Like

  • Youre a hands-on executor who thrives running process, not just designing it
  • Comfortable using modern HR tools (Rippling or comparable) and AI-powered tools to make people processes faster, more scalable, and more efficient - while keeping compliant tracking and documentation intact
  • Credible partnering with managers on performance conversations one day, and configuring an HRIS workflow the next
  • Trusted by both employees and managers to handle things fairly and efficiently

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of HR/HRBP experience
  • Experience building from scratch at a growth-stage company
  • Hands-on HRIS implementation experience (Rippling or comparable) - configuring job architecture, workflows, onboarding/offboarding flows
  • Experience running performance review, merit, or calibration cycles directly
  • Experience supporting or building career pathing frameworks
  • Experience building or running employee recognition and/or L&D programs
  • Experience using AI-powered tools to optimize, track, and run HR processes more efficiently - with a clear understanding of how to do so compliantly (e.g., data handling, documentation, avoiding bias in AI-assisted decisions

Preferred Experience

  • Experience operating in an Enterprise SaaS company
  • Multi-entity or international HR experience
  • Experience with Pave/Carta or similar benchmarking tools
  • Experience supporting benefits administration/broker renewals
  • Experience supporting employer-sponsored immigration cases (H-1B or similar)

jobDescription:
Job Summary

As a Senior Advisory Software Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of platform engineering and AI-driven automation. This is not a traditional SRE role. You will design, build, and supervise agentic systems that detect anomalies, diagnose failures, execute remediation runbooks, and escalate intelligently-with minimal human intervention. You will architect the feedback loops that make our platform progressively self-healing. You will collaborate across engineering, product, and architecture to ensure our observability and incident response capabilities stay ahead of system complexity. Being a Senior Advisory SRE here means you think in systems, build in agents, and measure success in mean-time-to-no-action.

Join Pitney Bowes as Senior Advisory Software Engineer

Years of experience: 9-12 years

Job Location: Pune

Responsibilities

  • Architect and operate agentic systems for autonomous monitoring, anomaly detection, and self-healing - reducing mean-time-to-remediation without human-in-the-loop dependency for routine failure patterns.
  • Build software and agentic pipelines that manage platform infrastructure autonomously - from drift detection and remediation to capacity adjustment and incident triage.
  • Drive reliability engineering outcomes - SLO attainment, error budget governance, and deployment velocity - by embedding intelligence into the platform rather than adding human process overhead.
  • Measure and continuously optimize system performance using agent-driven telemetry analysis - identifying degradation patterns before they manifest as customer-impacting incidents.
  • Own CI/CD reliability across the SDLC - integrating agentic checks, automated rollback triggers, and intelligent deployment gates that act on signal, not on schedule.
  • Scope includes:
    • Agentic observability - context-aware monitoring with LLM-assisted signal interpretation
    • Intelligent alert design - dynamic thresholds, noise suppression, and automated triage routing
    • Runbook automation and agentic remediation - codifying institutional knowledge into executable, supervised agent workflows
    • Autonomous incident response - agent-led detection, diagnosis, and escalation with human override at defined severity thresholds
    • Infrastructure lifecycle management - provisioning, drift remediation, and cost optimization driven by policy-as-code and agent execution
    • End-to-end configuration, deployment, and patching - governed by automated validation pipelines, not manual checklists
    • Creating and maintaining GIT repo and pipelines
  • Communicate risks, system health, and automation outcomes clearly to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders - translating agent behaviour and reliability signals into business-readable insight.
  • Define and continuously refine the observability strategy - what to monitor, how to act on it, and how to suppress noise programmatically. Drive adoption of agent-assisted monitoring across product and infrastructure layers.
  • Analyse operational behaviour patterns across user personas and platform workloads to inform intelligent automation design and monitoring strategy evolution.
  • Define and govern Service Level Indicators and Objectives - using error budget data to drive engineering prioritisation and calibrate automation intervention thresholds rather than to reactively defend the committed SLA.
  • Define, instrument, and own platform reliability metrics - QoS, Uptime, MTTR, MTBF, and agent automation coverage - as leading indicators of system health and team maturity.
  • Synthesise and publish key metrics to stakeholders
  • Leverage deep AWS expertise and DevOps toolchain knowledge to design infrastructure automation that operates with the reliability and predictability of a software system.
  • Continuously analyse infrastructure and tooling spend - identifying waste, right-sizing opportunities, and cost anomalies through automated FinOps signal processing.
  • Build and operationalise cost governance frameworks where agent-driven policy enforcement, not periodic human review, is the primary control mechanism.
  • Design and implement AI-augmented observability solutions across the stack - integrating SumoLogic, CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, and PagerDuty with agentic reasoning layers that interpret signal and act, not just alert.
  • Lead outage management with agentic support - automated problem detection, structured stakeholder communication, and agent-assisted resolution with clear human escalation protocols for high-severity events.
  • Own incident management and disaster recovery strategy - with automated runbook execution, agent-supervised recovery playbooks, and validated DR testing cadences.
  • Convert institutional knowledge into machine-executable runbooks and agent-accessible knowledge bases - ensuring operational intelligence is codified, versioned, and continuously improved
  • Lead operational improvement through continuous automation - replacing recurring manual processes with agent-driven workflows and measuring success by the reduction in human intervention per unit of platform activity.
  • Conduct rigorous incident postmortems and RCAs - using AI-assisted log correlation and timeline reconstruction to surface systemic gaps faster and drive durable corrective action.
  • Partner with development, QA, and architecture teams to embed reliability and automation requirements early in the SDLC - shifting reliability left rather than absorbing complexity at the production boundary.
  • Contribute to system design reviews with a reliability and automation lens - ensuring that agentic operability, observability hooks, and failure mode handling are first-class design considerations, not afterthoughts.
  • Provide senior technical leadership - setting the bar for agentic automation design, code quality in SRE tooling, and engineering rigour across the team.
  • Demonstrate Ownership and accountability.

Qualifications & Skills required

This is a critical service delivery role requiring experience with complex datacenter and cloud hosting environments. Pitney Bowes product hosting solutions leverage multiple technologies in complex data center and cloud environments that support multi-tiered high-availability applications. The role requires a talented self-directed and self-motivated individual with a strong work ethic and the following skills:

  • Graduate or Post-Graduate in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline - or equivalent demonstrated depth through professional experience.
  • 10+ years of SRE or platform engineering experience, with a demonstrable shift in recent years toward automation-first and AI-augmented operations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills - able to translate agent behaviour, reliability signals, and automation outcomes into clear engineering and executive narratives.
  • Strong background in SaaS product operations - with hands-on experience running multi-region, high-availability platforms at enterprise scale.

At Assurant, a Senior Software Engineer analyzes requirements and designs, codes, tests, installs and maintains application systems, programs, functions, services, and other related software components in response to enterprise needs of high complexity. The ideal candidate understands how to use AI to accelerate design, development, testing, code quality, documentation, troubleshooting, and operational excellence while maintaining strong engineering judgment and delivery accountability.


This position will be based in Hyderabad/Bangalore at our India location.

  • Design, implement, and maintain web applications used by both mobile and desktop users

  • Create and maintain documentation pertaining to code and engineering processes
  • Work in a collaborative environment by occasional pair and/or mob programming
  • Evaluate technical capabilities, options, and strategies
  • Communicating with Engineering Managers and Product Owners to plan and prioritize work and design technical solutions

title: Manager - Knowledge Management ((Corporate Law Firm))
jobDescription:
Candidates should have experience in Legal Industry, in Knowledge Management / Intellectual Property Management


Span of Control: Innovate Knowledge Solutions, Improve Lawyer Productivity, and Enhance Client Service delivery. S/he should also drive adoption of emerging technologies including AI, and others


Qualification: LLB / LLM (Mandatory)


Designation: Manager

Post Qualification Experience: 812 years of experience in Knowledge Management, preferably within a leading Law Firm or Professional Services organization


Location: Bombay


Reporting to: Chief Knowledge Officer


ROLE PURPOSE


The Manager - Knowledge Management will play a pivotal role in driving the firm's knowledge strategy, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing, and ensuring that legal knowledge assets are effectively managed, leveraged, and continuously enhanced to support business objectives.

The role requires a strategic thinker who can partner closely with Partners, Practice Heads, lawyers, and business services teams to develop innovative knowledge solutions, improve lawyer productivity, and enhance client service delivery. The incumbent will lead key KM initiatives, oversee the firm's knowledge repositories and precedent management programs, drive adoption of emerging technologies including AI, and ensure that knowledge resources remain accurate, accessible, and commercially valuable.

As a trusted advisor and relationship manager, the individual will collaborate across practice groups to identify knowledge gaps, implement best practices, and establish governance frameworks that promote consistency, quality, and efficiency throughout the firm.


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


Knowledge Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop, implement, and continuously refine the firm's Knowledge Management strategy in alignment with business goals and practice area priorities.
  • Partner with Practice Heads and Partners to identify strategic KM opportunities and drive knowledge-led initiatives.
  • Establish governance frameworks, policies, and standards for knowledge creation, maintenance, validation, and archival.
  • Lead firm-wide KM transformation and modernization initiatives.
  • Drive a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across the organization.

Legal Knowledge & Precedent Management

  • Oversee the firm's precedent, know-how, and legal content management programs.
  • Ensure high-quality, current, and commercially relevant precedents are maintained across all practice groups.
  • Develop frameworks for capturing, organizing, and disseminating legal know-how and matter experience.
  • Lead initiatives to capture tacit knowledge from senior lawyers and departing professionals.
  • Establish quality assurance processes for legal content and knowledge assets.

Knowledge Systems & Technology

  • Lead the evolution of KM platforms, document repositories, and knowledge solutions.
  • Work closely with IT, Digital, and Innovation teams to implement technology-driven KM solutions.
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled legal technologies, search solutions, and automation tools.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve knowledge discovery and lawyer productivity.
  • Ensure effective metadata, taxonomy, and content classification frameworks are maintained across KM systems.

Stakeholder Management & Relationship Building

  • Serve as the primary KM partner for assigned practice groups and business functions.
  • Build strong relationships with Partners, lawyers, and leadership teams to understand business requirements and deliver tailored KM solutions.
  • Act as a change champion to encourage adoption of KM initiatives and technologies.
  • Facilitate cross-practice collaboration and sharing of best practices.

Knowledge Sharing, Training & Communication

  • Develop and execute engagement programs to promote KM awareness and adoption.
  • Design and deliver KM training sessions, workshops, and awareness campaigns.
  • Support communication strategies that showcase KM successes, new resources, and thought leadership.
  • Create initiatives that encourage lawyer participation and knowledge contribution.

AI, Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive the adoption of AI and legal technology solutions to enhance knowledge capture, search, retrieval, and lawyer productivity.
  • Identify, evaluate, and implement AI-powered KM initiatives aligned with the firm's strategic objectives.
  • Partner with legal, technology, and business teams to develop scalable AI use cases and drive user adoption.
  • Establish best practices and governance frameworks for the responsible and secure use of AI within the firm.
  • Stay abreast of emerging AI and legal tech trends, continuously identifying opportunities to improve KM processes and user experience.
  • Measure the impact of AI initiatives through analytics and recommend enhancements to maximize business value.

Analytics & Performance Management

  • Develop KPIs and dashboards to measure KM effectiveness, engagement, and business impact.
  • Monitor usage patterns, search behavior, content contribution, and adoption metrics.
  • Provide strategic recommendations based on data insights.
  • Report KM performance and outcomes to leadership on a regular basis.

Team Leadership

  • Mentor and develop KM team members.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and performance management support.
  • Foster a high-performance, collaborative, and innovative team culture.
  • Manage multiple projects and priorities while ensuring timely delivery.


EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES


Education & Experience

  • A Law Graduate / Post-Graduate (mandatory) with 8-12 years of experience in Knowledge Management, preferably within a leading law firm or professional services organisation.
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing KM strategies.
  • Experience managing legal precedents, knowledge repositories, and content governance programs.
  • Strong exposure to legal research databases, document management systems, and enterprise search solutions.
  • Experience working with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, iManage, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered legal technologies and knowledge solutions.
  • Proven experience managing senior stakeholders, including Partners and Practice Heads.
  • Prior people management experience preferred

Essential Competencies (Skills & Attributes)

Strong understanding of legal Knowledge Management principles and best practices.

  • Expertise in precedent management, content governance, taxonomy development, and legal knowledge organization.
  • Strong understanding of legal research methodologies and legal information resources.
  • Experience implementing and managing enterprise KM platforms.
  • Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, legal technology solutions, and automation tools.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives.
  • Excellent project and change management skills.
  • Strong commercial awareness and business acumen.

Job Title: GenAI Architect

Role Overview

We are seeking a GenAI Architect to join the Thermax AI team and lead the organizations next-generation AI architecture and innovation agenda. This role combines deep architecture expertise with technology strategy to build scalable enterprise AI capabilities, evaluate emerging technologies, and shape Thermax’s long-term AI roadmap.

The focus is on defining future-ready AI architecture, building reusable platforms and accelerators, and enabling teams to deliver high-impact AI solutions. This is a hands-on role: you will not only define standards and patterns, but also build reference implementations, prototypes, and production-ready components alongside engineering teams. You will drive technical excellence, scalability, security, and innovation velocity across GenAI and agentic AI initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

AI Architecture Leadership

  • Define and own enterprise-wide GenAI architecture principles, standards, and reference patterns.
  • Design scalable, modular, and secure architectures for AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Establish reusable AI frameworks, components, and accelerators to speed up solution development.
  • Guide technical design decisions across Thermax AI Studio initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain reference implementations (e.g., RAG patterns, agent frameworks, evaluation harnesses) to accelerate adoption.
  • Review code and architecture for critical AI components and contribute directly to production code when needed.

Innovation & Emerging Technology Exploration

Continuously evaluate emerging technologies, including:

  • Generative AI / Foundation Models
  • Agentic AI and autonomous workflows
  • Multimodal AI
  • Open-source AI ecosystems
  • Industrial AI applications
  • Build rapid proofs of concept (POCs) and prototypes to validate new technologies.
  • Recommend build vs. buy vs. partner decisions for strategic AI capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities where AI can create competitive advantage for Thermax.

AI Platform & Technical Governance

  • Define standards for LLMOps, model lifecycle management, observability, and evaluation.
  • Establish responsible AI guardrails, security practices, and governance frameworks.
  • Conduct architecture reviews and ensure technical quality across solutions.
  • Drive platform decisions to ensure scalability, interoperability, and maintainability.

Technical Enablement & Solution Oversight

  • Partner with product, engineering, and delivery teams to translate business needs into scalable AI solution blueprints.
  • Provide architecture oversight and technical mentorship during solution implementation.
  • Support critical technical problem-solving and unblock engineering teams when needed.
  • Ensure solutions are production-ready and aligned with enterprise standards.

Capability Building & Thought Leadership

  • Mentor engineers and data scientists on GenAI best practices.
  • Build internal AI capability through reusable assets, standards, and knowledge sharing.
  • Conduct trainings and knowledge-sharing sessions to build an internal community of AI champions.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 10+ years of total experience, including 3+ years designing and deploying Generative AI / LLM-based solutions.
  • Core technical skills:
  • LLMs: GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral
  • RAG & vector stores: Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, Azure AI Search
  • Orchestration: LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen
  • Cloud platforms: Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI
  • Programming: Python (required); experience with TypeScript/Java/Go is a plus
  • Application engineering: building AI services/APIs (REST/gRPC), prompt/tooling interfaces, and integrations with enterprise systems
  • Quality & reliability: automated evaluation, testing, observability, and cost/performance optimization for LLM-powered systems
  • Proven experience designing scalable AI solutions, reusable frameworks, and cloud-native platforms.
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills and ability to influence technical direction across teams.
  • Experience in industrial, manufacturing, or IoT domains is a strong plus.

The Global HEOR Evidence Synthesis Manager plays a critical role in supporting Amgens global market access and health economics strategy through contributing statistical capabilities and methodological leadership for evidence synthesis methodologies (meta-analyses ITCs). jobDescription:
Senior Engineering Manager - Deccan AI
Deccan AI builds the data, evaluation, and agentic infrastructure that helps frontier labs and enterprises ship AI that actually works in production. Our Helix and EnterpriseOS platforms put humans and AI side by side to catch failures, close evaluation gaps, and run mission-critical workflows for some of the most demanding AI teams in the world.
Were looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead one of our core engineering pods. Youll own the delivery and technical health of a team building product and infrastructure that our customers depend on daily while staying close enough to the code to review a design doc, unblock a tricky bug, or make a build-vs-buy call with your team.
This is a player-coach role at a fast-moving startup: no large platform layer to hide behind, no multi-week approval chains. You set the bar for how your team ships, youre accountable for the outcomes, and you grow the engineers who report to you.

What were looking for
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years directly managing engineers or leading a team through delivery.
  • A strong individual-contributor foundation youve designed and shipped production systems yourself, not just reviewed other peoples PRs.
  • Experience managing in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where priorities shift and scope isnt handed to you fully formed.
  • Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.
  • Comfort operating across the stack backend systems, data pipelines, or applied ML/AI infrastructure enough to be credible with your team and with customers.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; you can explain a technical tradeoff to an engineer and to a VP in the same afternoon.
  • Bias toward action and high ownership you dont wait for a large team or perfect information to move.
What youll do
  • Own delivery for your teams roadmap: scoping, sequencing, and shipping product and infrastructure work against real customer and business deadlines.
  • Manage, mentor, and grow a team of engineers hiring, career development, performance feedback, and building a culture of ownership and high craft.
  • Stay technical: review architecture and design decisions, jump into code and incident response when it matters, and keep enough context to make good calls fast.
  • Partner closely with product, ML, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous requirements into a clear technical plan.
  • Build and refine the engineering processes (planning, code review, on-call, quality bars) that let the team move fast without breaking things.
  • Report on progress, risks, and tradeoffs to leadership with clarity and without spin.
  • Represent engineering in customer and cross-functional conversations when technical depth or judgment calls are needed.

Nice to have
  • Prior experience at an early- or growth-stage startup (Series A-C scale).
  • Background working with LLM infrastructure, evaluation pipelines, or agentic systems.
  • Experience managing distributed or hybrid teams.
Why Deccan AI
  • High-trust, high-ownership culture: capable people who move fast and hold a high bar.
  • Direct exposure to frontier AI labs and enterprise customers solving genuinely hard problems.
  • Real influence over how engineering scales as the company grows - youll help define the playbook, not just inherit one.
  • Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and a seat at the table as the company scales.

title: Lead Marketing Scientist
jobDescription:
About the Role

Lifesight is seeking a Lead Marketing Scientist to head a team of marketing scientists in developing advanced econometric and statistical models that solve complex marketing measurement problems. The role is anchored in scientific rigor and demands strong foundations in econometrics, causal inference, and statistical learning.

You will focus on building robust, interpretable, and scalable models - particularly in Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) - while ensuring causal validity and statistical soundness. Beyond hands-on modeling, you will mentor a team of data scientists and shape the evolution of measurement methodologies across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Econometric Modeling MMM Development
  • Lead the design and implementation of Marketing Mix Models (MMM), formulating business problems as rigorous quantitative and statistical models.
  • Build models using regression-based approaches (linear and non-linear), time series methods for trend, seasonality, and forecasting, and Bayesian and hierarchical modeling frameworks.
  • Incorporate core marketing science constructs, including adstock and lag effects, saturation and diminishing returns, and external drivers and control variables.
  • Ensure statistical robustness through proper model specification, parameter stability and interpretability, and sensitivity analysis.

Causal Inference Measurement Design
  • Apply causal inference methods such as difference-in-differences, synthetic control, and experimental and quasi-experimental designs.
  • Design and evaluate incrementality frameworks, including geo experiments and holdout testing.
  • Address endogeneity, confounding, and bias in observational datasets to ensure causal validity of model outputs.

Statistical Validation Diagnostics
  • Perform rigorous model validation, including residual analysis and diagnostics, multicollinearity checks, and out-of-sample and cross-validation.
  • Evaluate model performance using appropriate statistical metrics and ensure alignment with business outcomes.

Analytical Frameworks Model Integration
  • Develop integrated measurement frameworks that combine MMM, attribution, and experimentation.
  • Apply machine learning techniques where they enhance model performance without compromising interpretability.
  • Build scalable, reusable modeling approaches that strengthen the organization s measurement methodology.

Scientific Communication
  • Translate complex statistical outputs into structured, interpretable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Clearly articulate model assumptions, limitations, and implications, and support decision-making with evidence-based recommendations.

Team Leadership Capability Building
  • Lead and mentor a team of data scientists, establishing best practices in statistical modeling, code quality, and reproducibility.
  • Build team capability in advanced topics such as Bayesian modeling, causal inference, and experimental design.

Research, Delivery Collaboration
  • Stay current with advancements in econometrics, marketing science, causal inference, and statistical learning, and implement improved methodologies that enhance modeling accuracy and reliability.
  • Manage multiple analytical projects to defined timelines and quality standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure modeling outputs align with business needs.

Required Skills Experience
  • Experience: 8-12 years in advanced analytics, econometrics, or marketing science, with strong hands-on experience in Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM).
  • Technical expertise: Econometrics and regression modeling; time series analysis and forecasting; causal inference and experimental design; Bayesian statistics and hierarchical modeling (preferred).
  • Programming tools: Proficiency in Python or R, with strong experience in SQL and working with large datasets.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Master s or PhD in Statistics, Econometrics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Experience in marketing analytics or advertising measurement.
  • Exposure to SaaS-based analytics platforms.

Key Competencies
  • Strong quantitative and analytical reasoning, with scientific rigor and attention to detail.
  • Structured problem-solving and the ability to formulate ambiguous business questions as tractable statistical problems.
  • Clear, precise communication of technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to mentor and develop scientific talent.

What Success Looks Like
  • You create/help create statistically sound, interpretable MMM models delivered within Lifesight s methodology framework.
  • You Improve modeling efficiency by leveraging best-in-class AI to automate tasks and reduce manual effort.
  • You help create a high-performing, well-mentored team of marketing science professionals at lifesight.
  • Our clients are consistently satisfied and trust and act on our measurement insights.
