About AlphaSense:

The world s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the SP 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role

We are looking for an Enterprise Security Architect to join AlphaSenses Corporate Technology organization. Reporting directly to the VP of Secure IT, this is a senior individual contributor role responsible for defining and driving the security architecture strategy across our entire enterprise technology landscape spanning Zero Trust, identity, network, SaaS, endpoint, internal infrastructure, mobile, and operational technology.

You wont be handed a finished program. You will design it. Working at the intersection of security engineering, enterprise architecture, and business strategy, you will establish the frameworks, reference architectures, and technical standards that govern how AlphaSense builds and operates its technology environment securely at scale.

This role requires deep technical expertise paired with the ability to influence executive stakeholders, shape cross-functional programs, and operate as a force multiplier across Security Operations, Integrated IT, Information Engineering, and the business.

At the Staff level, you will:
  • Own the architecture: Define and maintain the enterprise security architecture across Zero Trust, identity, network, endpoint, SaaS, infrastructure, mobile, and OT domains.
  • Set the standard: Author and govern security architecture principles, reference designs, and technical standards adopted across the organization.
  • Lead without authority: Drive alignment across Security Operations, Corporate Technology, Information Engineering, and Integrated IT teams through technical credibility and structured decision-making.
  • Anticipate risk: Identify architectural gaps and emerging threat vectors before they become incidents, and prescribe remediation roadmaps.
  • Accelerate programs: Provide architecture leadership for strategic security initiatives including Zero Trust maturity, identity consolidation, SaaS governance, and device trust.
Responsibilities Zero Trust Network Security Architecture
  • Define and own the Zero Trust and Device Trust architecture strategy, including network segmentation, ZTNA policy design, and enforcement model across corporate and remote environments.
  • Architect Cloudflare WARP/Access and equivalent controls for secure remote access, replacing legacy VPN patterns with identity-aware, context-driven enforcement.
  • Design network security architecture for all office and data center environments including Meraki SD-WAN, firewall policy, 802.1X, and DNS security.
  • Establish architecture standards for microsegmentation, East-West traffic inspection, and lateral movement prevention.
Identity Access Architecture
  • Own the enterprise identity architecture spanning Okta, SAML/OIDC federation, SCIM provisioning, MFA, Privileged Access Management (PAM), and lifecycle governance across AlphaSense and Tegus tenants.
  • Design device trust and certificate-based authentication frameworks integrating MDM (Kandji, Intune), Okta FastPass, TPM/Secure Enclave, and hardware-bound credentials.
  • Define role-based access control (RBAC) architecture and Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) automation patterns for consistent enforcement across 200+ enterprise applications.
  • Architect identity federation patterns for MA integrations, third-party partners, and customer-facing systems.
Endpoint Mobile Security Architecture
  • Define the enterprise endpoint security architecture across macOS, Windows, and mobile platforms, including EDR (CrowdStrike Falcon), MDM policy standards, and patch management architecture.
  • Design mobile device management architecture for corporate and BYOD scenarios, establishing enrollment profiles, compliance policies, and conditional access integration.
  • Establish architecture standards for endpoint hardening, application allow-listing, DLP controls, and removable media policy.
  • Provide architectural oversight for RMM tooling and remote management capabilities, ensuring security boundaries and abuse-resistance controls are embedded by design.
SaaS Cloud Security Architecture
  • Define the SaaS security architecture program: vendor risk tiering, security review criteria, integration security standards, and ongoing posture monitoring frameworks.
  • Architect CASB, SSPM, and SaaS access governance controls to ensure visibility and enforcement across the business application portfolio.
  • Establish data classification and DLP architecture for SaaS environments including Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and Workday.
  • Design AI/shadow SaaS governance architecture, including browser isolation, OAuth scope enforcement, and sanctioned AI tooling controls.
Internal Infrastructure Security Architecture
  • Define security architecture standards for on-premise and cloud-hosted internal infrastructure including IDF/MDF environments, server rooms, physical access control systems (Brivo), and AV infrastructure.
  • Architect logging, SIEM integration, and telemetry collection frameworks ensuring consistent visibility across infrastructure, identity, network, and endpoint layers.
  • Design disaster recovery and resilience architecture for critical corporate infrastructure, including offline backup strategies and clean-room recovery playbooks.
Operational Technology (OT) Security
  • Develop OT security architecture standards for physical and building systems including access control hardware, environmental sensors, and network-connected facility equipment.
  • Define segmentation and monitoring architecture to isolate OT environments from corporate IT networks, reducing blast radius and unauthorized access risk.
  • Establish a vulnerability management framework for OT assets, accounting for patching constraints and availability requirements unique to operational environments.
Architecture Governance Engineering Enablement
  • Maintain a living enterprise security architecture document and domain-level reference architectures, keeping them current with technology changes and threat landscape evolution.
  • Conduct security architecture reviews for new technology programs, vendor onboarding, and significant infrastructure changes providing actionable guidance rather than just approval/denial.
  • Define security requirements and acceptance criteria for strategic projects in partnership with Product Security, Engineering, and Corporate Technology.
  • Produce architecture decision records (ADRs) and security design patterns that teams can reuse, reducing review cycle time and engineering rework.
Qualifications Required
  • 8+ years of experience in information security with at least 4 years in a security architecture, security engineering lead, or equivalent senior technical role.
  • Demonstrated expertise designing and implementing Zero Trust architectures in enterprise environments, including ZTNA, identity-aware access, and microsegmentation.
  • Deep knowledge of identity and access management Okta (or equivalent), SAML, OIDC, SCIM, MFA, PAM, and certificate-based authentication.
  • Strong endpoint security architecture experience across macOS and Windows, including EDR (CrowdStrike preferred), MDM (Kandji/Intune), and patch management.
  • Experience architecting SaaS security programs including vendor risk frameworks, CASB/SSPM tooling, and OAuth/API integration controls.
  • Solid understanding of network security architecture: firewalls, SD-WAN, 802.1X, DNS security, and network segmentation principles.
  • Familiarity with OT/IoT security architecture concepts and the challenges of securing non-traditional network-connected assets.
  • Proven ability to produce high-quality security architecture documentation including reference architectures, design patterns, and ADRs.
  • Strong communicator capable of presenting complex security topics to both technical peers and senior non-technical stakeholders.
Nice to Have
  • Professional certifications: CISSP, SABSA, CCSP, or equivalent architecture/security credentials.
  • Experience operating in a post-MA environment with multi-tenant identity and infrastructure consolidation challenges.
  • Familiarity with Cloudflare Access/WARP, Meraki, CrowdStrike Falcon, Kandji, Qualys VMDR, or Drata/GRC tooling.
  • Experience designing AI governance and shadow SaaS controls for enterprise environments.
  • Background working in a regulated industry or supporting compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP).

2. That model only works if someone inside is relentlessly tracking what every campaign, every agency and every deliverable is actually doing, day to day. This role exists to be that person the operating discipline behind an ambitious, fast-moving brand strategy, translating it into tracked, on-time, accountable execution across a wide network of external partners and a small internal team. 3. Why This Role Matters Every campaign that ships late, every agency deliverable that misses the brief, and every metric that isnt tracked is a gap between what the brand strategy promises and what actually happens in market. With this much riding on external partners, marketing cannot afford to lose that thread. This role is the single point of truth for whats live, whats due and how every agency and initiative is performing protecting the teams credibility with leadership and keeping a growing web of external partners genuinely accountable. 4. Purpose of the Role To convert brand and marketing strategy into tracked, on-time execution owning the campaign calendar in ClickUp, holding every agency partner accountable to performance and budget, keeping the teams OKR rhythm in Keka current in partnership with the Head of Brand Marketing, and preparing the numbers and narratives leadership needs to make decisions. 5. Key Responsibilities Campaign Project Tracking (ClickUp)
  • Own the master campaign and project tracker in ClickUp every brand, digital, PR, content and event initiative logged, timelined and clearly owned
  • Break every campaign down into tasks, owners and dependencies before work begins, and keep the tracker current, not retrospective
  • Run a single intake process for marketing requests from SBUs, sales and HR, so nothing gets actioned outside the tracked system
  • Plan and balance resourcing and capacity across the internal team and agency partners, so no one is silently overloaded
  • Run a consistent status rhythm that surfaces whats on track, at risk or slipping before it becomes a surprise to leadership
Agency Vendor Performance Management
  • Own performance trackers/scorecards for every media, design, creative, PR, content and event agency, and review them on a regular, non-negotiable cadence
  • Own agency retainers and media buying budgets, reallocating spend toward whats performing and flagging waste early
  • Flag underperforming agencies early, with data, and drive corrective action or escalation rather than letting issues quietly persist
  • Act as the final brand-compliance checkpoint on agency deliverables catching off-brand or off-strategy work before it ships
  • Coordinate with finance and legal on agency contracts, SOWs and invoicing schedules, flagging discrepancies early
Data, Reporting Executive Presentations
  • Track and report on marketing and brand metrics consideration, conversion, advocacy across every live campaign and agency relationship
  • Connect campaign data to real decisions conversion rate, CAC, ROAS so budget and priority shifts are based on what the numbers say, not instinct
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that turn raw campaign and agency data into clear, decision-ready numbers for the Head of Brand Marketing
  • Prepare and review executive-ready presentation decks for the Head of Brand Marketing translating dashboards and campaign/agency data into a clear leadership narrative
  • Maintain a single, current digital asset library so brand assets dont end up scattered across a dozen agency drives
Team Coordination OKR Rhythm
  • Own the operational rhythm and hygiene of OKRs in Keka ensuring every team members goals are logged, updated and visibly on track each cycle
  • Partner with the Head of Brand Marketing, who retains ownership of setting and formally evaluating each team members OKRs in line with how larger organisations typically split this (the direct line manager owns goal-setting and appraisal; this role owns the process, cadence and tracking around it)
  • Hold regular, calm delivery check-ins with each team member tracking progress against their OKRs and gently, consistently nudging accountability, without stepping into a formal appraisal role
  • Flag OKR risks or slippage to the Head of Brand Marketing early, with data, so goal-level conversations happen with full visibility
AI Tech-Enabled Operations
  • Use AI tools to speed up reporting, summarise campaign and agency performance, and remove manual busywork from tracking
  • Continuously look for ways to make ClickUp, Keka and reporting workflows more efficient for the whole team
  • Stay genuinely current on marketing tech and AI tools relevant to project tracking, reporting and content operations
6. Areas of Ownership
  • The single source of truth for every live campaign and project, tracked in ClickUp including a unified intake process and asset library
  • Agency and vendor performance and budgets tracked, reviewed and flagged on a set cadence
  • Brand-compliance sign-off on agency deliverables before they ship
  • The operational rhythm and hygiene of team OKRs in Keka logged, current and tracked with goal-setting and formal evaluation retained by the Head of Brand Marketing
  • Marketing and brand reporting and executive presentation decks used directly by the Head of Brand Marketing
7. First 30 / 60 / 90 Days First 30 Days Learn
  • Meet the Head of Brand Marketing, the internal team and every key agency partner; understand current campaigns, tools, budgets and reporting formats
  • Audit how work currently flows across project tracking, agency briefs, budgets and reporting, and identify the biggest gaps
  • Get every live campaign, budget and agency relationship logged and visible in one place in ClickUp

  • Ensure critical information is communicated clearly, consistently, and at the right time.

  • Identify customer support risks, operational dependencies, process implications, and training requirements.

  • Escalate risks and recommend mitigation strategies when needed.
  • Advocate for the customer and agent experience throughout launch planning and execution.

  • Experience using data and insights to inform decision-making.
  • Proven ability to identify risks, influence stakeholders, and drive accountability.

  • Experience supporting product launches, go-to-market initiatives, or operational readiness programs.
  • Experience supporting Marketing teams or Marketing initiatives.

The Business Performance Analytics Manager leads the Business Performance Analytics team supporting the Global Planning Network and Site Supply Chain organizations.   • Connect operational, planning, and financial insights into a cohesive business performance narrative that enables informed executive decision-making.
  • Facilitate cross-functional performance reviews that encourage collaboration, identify interdependencies, resolve performance gaps, and drive aligned improvement initiatives across the global network.
  • Promote a "One Supply Chain" mindset by ensuring analytics and performance reporting support enterprise outcomes rather than functional optimization.
Business Performance Analytics
  • Lead the Business Performance Analytics team supporting the Global Planning Network and Site Supply Chain organizations.
  • Define the analytics strategy, operating model, priorities, and roadmap aligned with Global Planning objectives.
  • Establish governance for GSC Planning KPI reporting, performance management, and business analytics.
  • Ensure timely delivery of recurring and ad hoc reporting.
  • Collaborate with Global Planning on translating business strategy into meaningful performance metrics and executive dashboards.
  • Present business insights and recommendations to Planning and Site Supply Chain leadership to support strategic decision-making.
Planning Network Analytics
  • Provide strategic analytics leadership across Supply Planning, Raw Materials Planning, Inventory Planning and Integrated Business Planning processes.
  • Partner with planning leaders to identify trends, risks, constraints, and opportunities that improve planning performance and supply reliability.
Site Supply Chain Analytics
  • Lead analytics supporting manufacturing and site supply chain operations.
  • Ensure consistent reporting and performance visibility across manufacturing sites while driving standardization of metrics and reporting processes.
Digital Analytics Business Intelligence
Lead the design and continuous improvement of enterprise analytics capabilities including:
  • Executive dashboards
  • KPI scorecards
  • Self-service reporting
  • Data visualization
  • Predictive analytics
  • AI-enabled decision support
Collaborate with AIN GSC Digital team in the development and support of reporting platforms including Tableau, Power BI, SAP Analytics Cloud, and other enterprise analytics tools.
Partner with Digital Technology and SAP teams to prioritize enhancements, improve reporting architecture, and increase automation across supply chain processes.
Financial Performance Value Delivery
  • Partner with Finance to improve visibility of supply chain financial performance including:
  • Budget tracking
  • Cost center performance
  • Logistics costs
  • Inventory carrying costs
  • Scrap performance
  • Forecast accuracy
  • Operational cost drivers
Develop analytics that enable proactive financial decision-making and quantify business value delivered through supply chain improvements.
Continuous Improvement Digital Transformation
Lead initiatives that simplify processes, automate reporting, improve data quality, and standardize analytics across the organization.
Champion:
  • Automation
  • AI-enabled analytics
  • Predictive modelling
  • Data governance
  • Process standardization
  • Digital transformation
Drive continuous improvement projects that improve operational efficiency, reporting effectiveness, and business outcomes.
Team Leadership Talent Development
  • Lead and develop the Business Performance Analytics Analyst team.
  • Prioritize and allocate work across the team to meet business commitments.
  • Build collaborative relationships with planning and site supply chain leaders.
  • Ensure consistent KPI definitions, reporting standards, and data quality across supported functions.
  • Facilitate cross-functional performance reviews and support governance forums.
  • Drive continuous improvement, automation, and analytics capability within the team.
  • Coach and develop team members while fostering a collaborative, customer-focused culture.
Basic Qualifications
8-13 years of experience in Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Operations, Finance, Engineering, or related business functions
OR
Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience consistent with Amgen qualification requirements.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience leading or supervising business analytics, business intelligence, supply chain, planning, or operations teams in a complex global organization.
  • Strong knowledge of end-to-end supply chain planning processes, including Supply Planning, Raw Materials Planning, Inventory Planning, Integrated Business Planning (IBP), Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics, and Site Supply Chain operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to build collaborative relationships and influence cross-functional stakeholders across global and site organizations to achieve shared business objectives.
  • Experience developing enterprise performance dashboards, KPI frameworks, executive reporting, and business performance scorecards.
  • Knowledge of SAP platforms (S/4HANA, ECC, Fiori, IBP) and enterprise reporting and analytics tools such as Tableau, Power BI, SAP Analytics Cloud, BusinessObjects, SQL, Python, or Databricks.
  • Experience leading process improvement, reporting standardization, automation, and digital transformation initiatives that improve business performance and operational effectiveness.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, and master data management principles.
  • Experience partnering with Finance to support business performance reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and operational performance analysis.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex data into meaningful business insights for diverse audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams, develop talent, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

jobDescription:
Test Automation Architect Manager

The Test Automation Architect Manager is a pivotal leadership role responsible for defining, architecting, and driving the test automation strategy and implementation across enterprise programs, with a strong focus on TOSCA. This role will lead the design and deployment of robust, scalable test automation frameworks, ensuring efficient and effective quality assurance. Furthermore, the role will strategically explore and integrate AI capabilities to enhance test automation, including intelligent test case generation, defect prediction, and test data management. This position requires a blend of hands-on test automation expertise, architectural leadership, strategic thinking, and strong stakeholder communication, ensuring the continuous improvement and innovation of our test automation practices.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architect, design, and implement enterprise-level test automation frameworks and strategies, primarily leveraging TOSCA.
  • Drive the adoption, optimization, and governance of TOSCA across various projects and teams, ensuring adherence to best practices.
  • Lead the development of scalable, maintainable, and efficient automated test suites for functional, regression, API, and performance testing.
  • Evaluate, select, and integrate various test automation tools and technologies, including AI-driven solutions, into the existing ecosystem.
  • Define and implement best practices for test automation, coding standards, and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
  • Strategically explore and apply AI/ML techniques to enhance test automation, such as intelligent test case optimization, predictive analytics for defect detection, and AI-powered test data generation.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to test automation engineers and teams.
  • Collaborate closely with development, product, and QA teams to ensure testability, identify automation opportunities, and align on quality goals.
  • Establish clear metrics and reporting for test automation effectiveness, efficiency, and Return on Investment (ROI), including AI-driven insights where applicable.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, particularly in test automation, AI, and generative AI, advocating for their strategic adoption where beneficial.
  • Manage stakeholder communication regarding test automation progress, challenges, and strategic initiatives.

AI & GenAI Application in Testing Skills:

  • Understanding how AI/ML can be applied to optimize test processes, such as intelligent test selection, defect prediction, self-healing automation, and anomaly detection.
  • Familiarity with concepts like prompt engineering and RAG pipelines for potentially generating test data, test cases, or test scripts using GenAI.
  • Ability to evaluate, integrate, and champion the adoption of AI-driven testing tools and platforms to improve efficiency and coverage.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
  • 10+ years of experience in Quality Assurance and Test Automation, with at least 3-5 years in an Architect or Lead role.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with TOSCA Testsuite, including deep expertise in TDM, API testing, UI automation, and CI/CD integration.
  • 2+ years of experience with AI/ML concepts and their application in enhancing test automation, intelligent testing, or quality engineering processes.
  • Proven experience in designing and implementing end-to-end test automation strategies for complex enterprise applications.

Tools & Technologies

Must Have Tools

  • TOSCA Testsuite (including TDM, API, UI automation)
  • Test Management tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, ALM Octane)
  • CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Azure Pipelines, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)
  • Programming languages for scripting (e.g., Python, Java, C#)
  • Version Control Systems (e.g., Git)

Good To Have Tools

  • Selenium, Playwright, Cypress or other open-source automation frameworks
  • API testing tools (e.g., Postman, SoapUI, Karate)
  • Performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner)
  • Cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP) for test environment management
  • Basic understanding of ML/AI frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch) for specific test automation use cases.

Nice To Have Tools

  • AI-powered test data generation or intelligent test case selection tools
  • Predictive analytics tools for quality insights and defect prediction
  • RPA tools for broader process automation in testing
  • Experience with other commercial automation tools (e.g., UFT, Worksoft)
  • GenAI tools for prompt engineering in test case design or script generation (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex)

Communication:

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts, influence stakeholders, and present strategic roadmaps effectively.

Additional Information:

  • Travel Requirements: Travel to client locations may be required as per project requirements.
  • Shift Requirements: Required to work on shift as per project requirements.
  • Line of Service: Advisory
  • Industry: Enterprise Testing Managed Services
  • Designation: Manager
  • Location: Bangalore, India (ONLY)

We are looking for an AI - IT/OT Network Infrastructure Security Manager to act as the technical owner for client-facing network Infrastructure Security transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a hands-on manager who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. This role is part of the Cyber Frontier AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.

  • Lead the design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
  • Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
  • Oversee deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE,DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
  • Lead incident response and security improvement initiatives to enhance cyber resilience across hybrid infrastructure.

  • Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.

  • Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
  • Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
  • Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
  • Enable AI-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
  • Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm s AI Network Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
  • Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.

Required qualifications

  • 8 12 years of experience across AI driven Network Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.
  • Experience with OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
  • Expertise in XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
  • Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
  • Strong capability in multi-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
  • Strong client-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.

Ideally, you ll also have

  • Good soft skills i.e. verbal written communication, technical document writing etc
  • Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
  • Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
  • Customer orientation skills
  • Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
  • Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco others)

Why join us

Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network infra structure security portfolio in an AI-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network infrastructure security practice as technology-enabled, consulting-led, and globally delivered.

Typical work environment

  • Global, cross-functional teams
  • Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
  • Exposure to strategic client programs and market-shaping offerings
  • Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model

EY | Building a better working world



EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.



Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.



Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across Indias national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments, supporting the Ministry of Health Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.

As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of Indias health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCFs effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.

Our work is built around four complementary roles: as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.

WJCFs programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases, syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross-cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health.

We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.

Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.

WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.

Project Background:

Over the past seven years, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY) has become one of the largest health-assurance programmes in the world. It has issued more than 44 crore Ayushman cards and authorised over 11.1 crore hospital admissions worth around 1.73 lakh crore, across a network of more than 38,000 empanelled hospitals. Running at this scale, the programme has generated a large volume of data as a by-product of its everyday operations, built up over seven years of registrations, pre-authorisations, claims, and utilisation records. Making sense of data this size has never been easy, but Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) now provide an opportunity to derive meaningful insights from this rich repository of data more systematically, robustly, more quickly and in a manner that is more actionable than previously possible or conceivable. This in turn provides a clearer picture of how the scheme is working, and of the ways in which even further value can be delivered to citizens by the scheme, giving the National Health Authority (NHA) a real opportunity to refine the programme and sharply improve its effectiveness.

The NHA, an attached office of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare with full functional autonomy, implements AB PM-JAY and also drives the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), now a mature layer of national digital health infrastructure that includes registries such as the Health Facility Registry and the Healthcare Professionals Registry and platforms such as the National Health Claims Exchange (NHCX). ABDM follows a federated architecture built on privacy and security by design, which means there is no central store of health records. A patients clinical records stay with the facility that created them and move only as encrypted FHIR bundles, with the patients consent, so the NHA never looks inside an individuals health record. What it can work with is aggregated and metadata-level information, for example how actively facilities and providers are participating, or how registration compares with actual use, and even this is enough to reveal patterns that help strengthen the programme.

Turning this potential into practical insight needs dedicated, specialised capacity. The Health Analytics and AI Unit (HAAU) is the NHAs in-house capability for advanced analytics and AI, set up to do exactly this. WJCF supported the NHA in preparing the HAAU Vision Document and, through a team embedded at the NHA, has helped take it from vision to delivery, producing analyses and tools that are already changing how the NHA uses its data. WJCF is now expanding the HAAU with a set of specialised roles to accelerate delivery and catalyse the development of institutionalised capability within the NHA. All of this work is done with privacy by design and strong data governance, in line with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023 and the Strategy for Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare for India (SAHI).

Position Summary

WJCF is looking to hire a Health Financing Specialist within the Health Analytics and AI Unit (HAAU), embedded within the NHA and reporting to the HAAU Lead. This role brings dedicated health-financing and health-economics capability to the unit, working across the questions at the core of AB PM-JAY: benefit-package selection, evidence-based package pricing and costing, strategic purchasing and value-based care, and the cost-benefit of beneficiary-inclusion and eligibility decisions. The selected candidate will play a key role in shaping the analytical agenda of the HAAU with a view to firmly establish AB-PMJAY on a path towards financial sustainability while continuing to scale towards Universal Health Coverage. Working as part of one integrated team, the Specialist shapes financing questions into clear hypotheses and requirements, and turns the schemes own claims, utilisation, and cost data into evidence for package design, pricing, and purchasing decisions.

This position is based out of the NHA office in New Delhi, so that the individual stays closely aligned with the NHAs immediate priorities and the rapidly evolving digital health landscape. This role provides an excellent opportunity for a health-financing professional who would like to shape the financial sustainability of Indias flagship health protection programme.

  • Work across the questions at the core of AB PM-JAY: such as benefit-package selection, evidence-based package pricing and costing, strategic purchasing and value-based care, and the cost-benefit of beneficiary-inclusion and eligibility decisions.
  • Support the move to claims transparency as AB PM-JAY empanelled hospitals transition to raising claims through the National Health Claims Exchange (NHCX).
  • Turn claims, utilisation, and cost data into evidence for package design, pricing, and purchasing decisions, working closely with the units data-science skills.
  • Design and model financing and purchasing options and quantify their fiscal impact.
  • Produce clear options papers and decision-ready recommendations for senior NHA leadership.
  • Embed privacy-by-design and strong health data governance across the financing work, consistent with the DPDP Act 2023 and SAHI, and perform other responsibilities as requested by WJCF and NHA leadership.
